One big disappointment.
Dec 2025 • Family
We do not understand why this got such high ratings from other customers. In short. The food tasted good, but it was very greasy, salty and very spicy. Ok, the latter may be too subjective but still. The Naan bread was absolutely drenched in fat. 
We love Indian food and have been to quite some good India restaurants around the Globe but this was definitely not up there. The whole place was not clean and looked unsanitary (sticky tables, floors, etc). They couldn’t hack with the number of customers, our orders weren’t taken and we received our drinks only after a long time. To top things off we had a couple smoking cigarettes next to us. One big disappointment.

Rude service
Apr 2025 • Solo
Rude staff.. I ordered serval items and said I'd order some more if still hungry, but was told "you order now". Really! 

There was music outside, but only three tables, which were taken. Inside felt so uncomfortable. It was silent, with no music/atmosphere at all, and offensively bright lighting.

I was sat at a table with a dirty stained table cloth. 

The food was actually pretty good. The garlic naan is very good. Peppered cauliflower overcooked, but tasty. Tandoori fish, maybe a little under on a couple of bits, but again, tasty.

On the food alone I would have gone back, but it felt like the main guy just wanted to throw the food at me and get me to move on so, on service alone, I'll pass.

So good, we ate on consecutive nights
Jan 2025 • Couples
I was very pleasantly surprised to experience authentic Indian food in Ninh Binh. We had the Bihari Kabab, Seekh Kabab, Dal Makhani and Tadka daal. 

The Bihari kabab literally melted in our mouths. It was flavorful, very tasty and well spiced. It hit the spot. The Seek kababs were simply delicious. We had the Daals on two separate nights and each one of them reminded me of my childhood.

The service was exceptional. The manager - Mr. Goel gave us a very warm welcome and kep us company during our dinner. The bartender/waiter - Vajinder, was exceptionally nice, warm and was so attentive to all customers in the restaurant. We enjoyed our dinner the first night so much that we went back the second night and received even better service.
